blocks.text: This video shows icons that play once when a list comes into view, and then stay as they are. It suits things you see once, like a tip or a reminder. Our dashboard has a list further down, with a tip, a reminder, and a reply. Let's give each item its animated icon.

blocks.alt: Autoplay plays each file as it says. These files play once, and only start when they can be seen.

blocks.text: Autoplay plays each file as it says. These files play once, and only start when they can be seen. Let's scroll down to the list.

blocks.alt: Each icon draws itself once as the list appears, and then stays, finished.

blocks.text: Each icon draws itself once as the list appears, and then stays, finished. So, an icon that plays once and stays is a setting in its file. Autoplay follows it, and starts it when the list comes into view.
